review.summary: The existing Chthoniobacter and Parachlamydia descriptors now retain native genus correspondences supported by two and thirteen reference genomes. Ochrobactrum retains all three ordered generic alternatives. Three statuses, two blocks, one candidate list and two native inline events changed. All source profiles, fungal exclusions, previous mappings, biological assertions and older history remain intact. Eight actual native commands and one sidecar bind the exact M5 application; the earlier four scientific findings remain unresolved.

limitations: Partial technical diagnostic with scientific_review:false. These three assessments and eight scoped native commands are not complete scientific review, full QC, source-snippet validation or completion of the broad campaign.

Primary reading covers selected retained main-text Methods2.2.7 and Results/Discussion profiling and MC-product passages. No new whole-paper, S5 classifier supplement, figure-pixel, sequence or source-genome audit occurred.

The selected members are genus-level relative amplicon profiles without isolated-stock designations. Chthoniobacter2/2 and Parachlamydia13/13 reference populations are not experimental read fractions, absolute growth, viable strains or identified DCF-degrading members. All three Ochrobactrum genus alternatives remain unselected.

The two existing Burkholderia/Klebsiella mapping blocks and five fungal NO_GTDB_EQUIVALENT entries remain unchanged. Their old latest/build wording is not newly certified; rounded fractions are not unanimity. The crosswalk hash identifies exact bytes, while its release is unestablished and its file mtime is not a release label. Local NCBI authority observations use file-stat provenance, not full database hashing or ontology release certification.

The immutable earlier full review remains needs_curation with four findings: product-scope, classifier-resolution, medium-completeness and gtdb-provenance. Existing2687 was verified open in the retained snapshot. The top-level unsupported5-OH-DCF wording, combined S5 Burkholderia/Caballeronia/Paraburkholderia assignment, twelve missing basal medium constituents and unselected mapping provenance remain unresolved.

Retain the ten-member partial roster, separate16S/ITS denominators, 3g/L glucose, 28-day community parent loss versus detoxification/mineralization, distinct CSWD isolate products and tentative NO2-DCF. Two community-level nodes and no arrows remain; relative profile change does not establish direct catabolism or a causal workflow.

Actual M5 stage/application and all eight commands ran at cfa5f0934c5e52a3945fc5bd8162daaa03ee9ba5 with Python3.13.2. Route preparation ran locally at3973ff3358bbc3edbbd97734602ad5fae7272e67 and used Python3.13.12. Later source preparations and local mirrored bytes do not relabel those actual execution revisions.

The eight commands comprise native history scaffolding and seven scoped validators. Strict historical admission, both current379/441 predicates in sharedbatch33, generated products, measured reference validation and aggregate M5 QC remain separate. Preserve Drosophila160 research status and the literal historical ledger; this diagnostic clears none of those requirements.
